title: Remote nodes (ESP-NOW)
notAvailable: Remote nodes are not available in this hub firmware.
radioRunning: On, channel {channel}: the same as your Wi-Fi router's.
radioAuto: Starts by itself when a node is paired (factory setting).
offTitle: Turn the radio for nodes off?
offBody: The nodes stop sending: their points get no live values and no history until the radio is on again. The hub remembers this after a restart.
pairIntro: Press «Pair a node», then power the node up. Each node brings up to {n} points.
pairingHow: Power the node up now. It shows up below in a few seconds.
pairNeedsRadio: Turn the radio for nodes on to pair one.
full: The hub takes up to {max} nodes. Remove one to pair another.
historyLeft: History: {used} of {n} points in use. Points beyond {n} show live values only.
historyFull: History: all {n} points are in use. A new node's points will show live values only.
paired: Paired in this window: {n}. Their points are already added; no restart needed.
acceptedReboot: Added. Restart the hub to register the node's points.
disabledHint: The hub discards this node's data until you turn it back on. Energy for that time isn't kept.
notHeard: not heard since the hub started
removeBody: The node and its points (channels: {n}) are removed, with their stored history, for good. Download the history first in History (CSV) if you need it. To use the node again, pair it again.
errOff: The radio for nodes is off. Turn it on first.
errStart: The hub couldn't start the radio for nodes. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart the hub.
errRegistry: The hub couldn't change its node list (full, or the node isn't known).
errBadRequest: The hub didn't accept the request.
actionFailedHint: The hub didn't answer. Check the connection and try again.
cfgCtHint: Pick the clamp actually fitted to each channel: a wrong one scales its readings wrongly. A channel turned off stops measuring.
cfgAllOff: At least one channel has to stay on.
cfgOffline: The node is offline. It takes the settings when it's back.
cfgSent: Sent. The node applies the settings on its next contact; the card shows «settings not applied yet» until it confirms.
disableBody: The hub discards the node's data while it's off: that energy won't be in History or the totals, and turning it back on doesn't bring it back. To pause a node and keep its energy, leave it on.
errNotFound: The hub doesn't know this node any more. Reload the page.
errPeriod: The hub takes only the 15-minute period.
